_comment: Visual-only strike-field dressing. Local Z follows the existing Glass Field to Dynamo Outer Works route. Clusters remain outside the 14 m critical-road corridor and add no collision, interaction, progress, encounter, terrain, camp or harvest changes.
_why_scorched_scars: F10#4 scene-art pass (owner 5860380772): strike scars as terrain-following burnt glass-fused patches with the grass cleared, blackened rock-family lumps and low smoked-glass blades. Enabled for Phase 1b; the old spire clusters remain only as a legacy fallback.

seam_clear_1104._why_on: ON (VIS-STORMWOOD qj_seam, 4 Nov 2026): CPU three-judge quick_judge A/B, calibrated slope 1.52, r 0.99, anchor RMSE 0.14: F41#19 Glass Field spike bases 4.34 -> 5.30 mapped (3/3 score the candidate higher; defect PRESENT -> PARTIAL).
seam_clear_1104._why: VIS-STORMWOOD qj_basalt (4 Nov 2026), F41#19 P2-043: the basalt mound judged worse (5.25 -> 4.42); 3/3 preferred the shipped purple-cyan glass crust but named 'a rigid thin white line' (the straight emissive fissure ribbons), grass passing through the crust edge, and a crust 'much wider than the cluster'. On (stormwood_glass_field.gd _seam_clear): no fissure ribbons, grass cleared across the whole scar (1.0 instead of 0.82) and the glass crust at 0.6 of the scar width instead of 0.9. Visual only. OFF until judged.

basalt_crust_1104._why: VIS-STORMWOOD (4 Nov 2026), F41#19 P2-043 (CPU v1/b16 5.45; judges: 'blue glass spikes rise from a flat dark base', 'needs a fix to the slab base itself'). The CPU walk_03 frame shows the fused crust model as a 12 m glossy purple plate under the spikes. On (stormwood_glass_field.gd _basalt_crust): the crust becomes a low basalt mound at 0.42 of the scar width, 0.7 m tall and sunk 0.25 m, matte dark grey with no emission, so the spikes break out of rock on cleared ground. Visual only. OFF until judged.

rock_collar_candidate._why: P2-043 (GPU WD2 1 Nov, 5.75): the spike base is still a flat dark slab, not rooted in rock. On: five installed rock-family stones in cracked basalt grey ring each Meshy spike cluster's foot, half sunk (ring 0.16 and stone height 0.11 of the spike height), and the flat fused scar patch is hidden so the spikes break out of rock on cleared ground. Visual only, colliders removed (stormwood_glass_field.gd _add_rock_collar). OFF until GPU judged.

meshy_spikes._candidate: World dressing P2-043 (OFF until GPU judged; coordinator Meshy batch 31 Oct, assets/props/meshy-1031/glass_spikes, provenance there). GPU 5.15: a flat purple sheet with a few low blue shards. Per cluster one main spike cluster at 0.75 of the cluster height and three satellites, varied in scale and yaw, seated inside the cleared scar; the primitive blades are skipped. Crystal texels take the blue-vein glow.

scar_relief_candidate._comment: P2-043 unjudged shading-only candidate: metre-scale relief on the existing fused scar surface using the shared Stormwood detail include. No new mesh, colour/alpha change, grass clearance or collision change. Original geometric surface normals remain the reference.

shard_finish._comment: F41 round-3 candidate (OFF until judged): taller, brighter fused-glass blades so the Glass Field scar reads at the fixed stand (three round-1 judges: a tiny dark smear). Visual only; no collision or placement change.
shard_finish._why_crystal_model_candidate: F41 r14 candidate (Stormwood lane, 24 Oct 2026; coordinator Meshy, provenance in the asset folder): copy to crystal_model with crystal_height_scale 0.55 for one fulgurite cluster per scar. Judged in r14 with the Stormheart v3 swap and an interior fill lift: matrix mapped Calm 5.75 / Break 4.98 / aftermath 5.90 vs main 5.53 / 4.83 / 5.63 (CPU, gain under 0.5). OFF.
